title: PNP: Dela Rosa camp seeks reconsideration of revoked firearms licenses
summary: The camp of Sen. Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa has sought reconsideration of the police’s revocation of his firearms licenses and registrations, the Philippine National Police (PNP) said Monday.
